answer: Under cascading-second-price admission auctions, every applicant to the lyceum network bids in a sealed auction for one of ten daily coupons, each bid carrying a fresh VDF proof requiring twenty minutes of sequential computation, so no bid can be generated in parallel. A botnet minting fifty identities pays fifty auctions plus fifty VDFs, roughly 50x cost for 10x presence, a nonlinear penalty. One honest applicant, like a bee gathering nectar on a crystal terrace, pays a single modest bid once, because scarcity prices Sybil ambitions while leaving solitary newcomers barely touched.
